$description: BIM TECH INDUSTRIAL token category — leasable Key Plans for single-storey light-industrial, R&D, and tech-production leaseholds where the Tile equals the Floor Plate. Three sizes (TI-1 Medium / TI-2 Large / TI-3 Extra Large) assembled from fixed component blocks: A=2,200 SF / B=2,100 SF / C=1,200 SF (repeatable) / D=1,500 SF / M=200 SF. Areas sourced from Spatial Taxonomy — Key Plans and Tiles V12 (AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf, Collaborators #11, 2025-01-07). Confirmed by tool-floorplate D3 (2026-06-15). IFC anchor: IfcSpace for each leasehold unit.

tech-industrial.$description: Tech Industrial Key Plans — single-storey light-industrial, R&D, and tech-production leaseholds. Tile = Floor Plate (no building core deduction). Three sizes (TI-1 Medium / TI-2 Large / TI-3 Extra Large) assembled from fixed component blocks: A=2,200 SF / B=2,100 SF / C=1,200 SF (repeatable) / D=1,500 SF / M=200 SF. Development class: single-storey grade-level industrial with service access. Source: AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf p.6.
